assumptions: GTEx v8 tissue medians stand for each tissue's expression.
Genes nearest in mean expression are the right peers.
limits: Answers 'across tissues', not 'across samples of one tissue'.
A stability ranker always finds a most stable gene; only the peer null says whether any is stable at all.
bio.jane/contract.question: Are candidate reference genes more or less variable across human tissues than genes of the same abundance?

description: Ask whether the genes used to normalize expression (reference or housekeeping genes, such as GAPDH, ACTB or B2M) are more or less variable across human tissues than genes of the same abundance, on GTEx v8 median expression. Each candidate's standard deviation of log2(TPM + pseudocount) across the chosen tissues is ranked among the genes nearest it in mean expression (1,000 by default, from the 19,107 protein-coding genes GTEx measures), giving one p for 'more variable than its peers' and one for 'steadier', each corrected across the candidates. The four rankers the field runs (geNorm M, NormFinder, BestKeeper, comparative ΔCt, and RefFinder's consensus) also order the candidates against each other, reading the tissues as samples. A ranker always finds a most stable gene; the null says whether any candidate is stable at all. Tissue medians hide the variation between people within a tissue, so this answers 'across tissues', not 'across samples of one tissue'.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alpha.description: false discovery rate at which a candidate is called more variable, or steadier, than its peers.

correction.description: Benjamini–Hochberg (independent or positively dependent tests) or Benjamini–Yekutieli (any dependence; less power). Values: BH (Benjamini–Hochberg), BY (Benjamini–Yekutieli).

genes.description: the candidate reference genes, as current HGNC symbols (GAPD is GAPDH).

neighbours.description: how many genes nearest in mean expression each candidate is ranked among. The smallest p it can give is 1 / (neighbours + 1).

pseudocount.description: added to TPM before the logarithm, so a tissue with no expression has one. Advanced.

tissues.description: GTEx tissue names to compare across, three or more; empty means all 54.

name: discover_reference_stability

candidates.description: every candidate's mean and SD of log2 expression, the expression band of its peers, its percentile among them and both p and q

rankers.description: geNorm M, NormFinder, BestKeeper, comparative ΔCt and the RefFinder consensus over the candidates

stable.description: the candidates steadier than their expression peers at the chosen false discovery rate

unstable.description: the candidates more variable across tissues than their expression peers at the chosen false discovery rate
